name: Lead Skeleton
languages: the languages it knew in life but can’t speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The skeleton is immune to any spell or effect that
would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The skeleton has advantage on saving throws
against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The skeleton’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lead skeleton makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14
(2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
